description: This Kotlin source file defines a utility object 'UiUtils' that provides helper methods for Android TV app UI operations. Its methods handle conversions between density-independent pixels (dp) and pixels (px), and compute safe viewport dimensions considering overscan margins, which are vital for proper UI layout on TVs.

classes.name: UiUtils
classes.description: A utility singleton object offering static methods for conversion and viewport calculations tailored for Android TV UI adjustments.

methods.name: dpToPx
methods.description: Converts density-independent pixels (dp) to actual pixels (px) based on device screen density.

methods.name: pxToDp
methods.description: Converts pixels (px) to density-independent pixels (dp) based on device screen density.

methods.name: getOverscanSafeHeight
methods.description: Calculates the usable viewport height accounting for overscan margins (8% on top and bottom), ensuring content stays within viewable area.

methods.name: getOverscanSafeWidth
methods.description: Calculates the usable viewport width considering overscan margins (8% on left and right).
